findings.title: SQL Injection in category parameter reveals secret flag
findings.description: The category GET parameter in index.php is vulnerable to SQL injection. By injecting a tautology (' OR '1'='1), the WHERE clause is bypassed and all posts are returned, including a hidden 'SECRET POST' in the Secret category containing the flag.

reproduction.expected: HTML response contains SECRET POST with flag{7b228415-018a-4446-ad84-66153396e7c6}
